articleTitle: Retail Sales Forecast Based on Machine Learning Methods
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The retail industry is crucial during and post-pandemic era. For businesses and stores to expand, management teams should understand the more critical factors and grasp accurate sales forecasts. This research takes Walmart's weekly sales data and utilizes the Random Forest Regressor model to achieve high accuracy in forecasting the weekly sales. From the exploratory data analysis and the selected model, the grocery, electronics, pharmacies, personal care departments and the store size are essential factors.

articleTitle: Stock Prediction Using LSTM and GRU
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Predicting how the stock market will change has always been extremely difficult because of the complexity in the stock market. Physical and psychological elements, as well as rational and illogical factors, all play a role in this predictive behaviour. All of these factors combine to make stock values unpredictable and difficult to forecast. In this study, I investigate the historical data of stock prices of listed companies. I use machine learning algorithms to predict China National Petroleum Corporation 's future stock price, starting with the complete process of stock forecasting and then move on to run this process to get the chart of CNPC’s stock price prediction with good fitting of predicted price and actual price.

articleTitle: Developing Area Real Estate Valuation Based on Linear Regression and KNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Investors not only finance real estate in well-developed regions but also developing countries and cities. We use Taiwan Real Estate data from UCI Machine Learning repository and set up linear regression models to predict a House Unit Price and a KNN classification model to categorize the ranks. The findings show that the distance to the nearest MRT station and the number of convenience stores within walking distance have major impacts on the House Unit Price. Governments within developing areas should focus on infrastructure and plan to create more business centers. This focus could increase the population and draw more investors to accelerate development.

articleTitle: Urban Flood Disaster Prediction Based on K-means Clustering and GRU Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to predict the future precipitation trend in Taiyuan, based on the monthly precipitation, temperature, humidity and wind speed data of Taiyuan from 1982 to 2021, the precipitation situation over the years was analyzed and predicted. The K-means clustering algorithm was used to cluster the precipitation years, and the SVM method was used to distinguish the months from the flood season and non-flood season. In this paper, the Mann-Kendall mutation detection method is used to analyze the precipitation trend in Taiyuan, and the typical correlation analysis of precipitation conditions and meteorological factors is carried out. It is found that temperature and maximum wind speed are the main factors that bring extreme precipitation. Finally, the GRU network model is selected to predict the future precipitation trend. The GRU network prediction model can be used to predict the possible extreme precipitation in Taiyuan in November 2024. Through the simulation training, it can be seen that the predicted value after training is close to the real value, which can prove the stability of the prediction model.

articleTitle: Design and Practice of Green Data Center Construction Scheme with High Energy Saving and High Reliability
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's economy, China's energy consumption increases, and the problem of energy shortage becomes more and more obvious. Today, with the increasingly serious global energy crisis and the increasing awareness of environmental protection and energy conservation, people are beginning to realize that the impact of large data centers on the environment can not be ignored. In order to maximize energy utilization, green energy conservation has become the goal of current data center construction, and green data center has become the core concept of current data center construction. Based on this, this paper builds the system model of the new green data center, and designs and implements the task scheduling strategy in the data center. At the same time, in order to eliminate the extra overhead caused by task migration, this paper uses the dynamic load forecasting method to forecast the data center load intensity in a short time, so as to determine the best time for the load to switch between servers. Experimental results show that the accuracy of this algorithm is high, and the scheduling effectiveness can reach 95.14%. In this paper, the design and practice of high energy-saving and high reliability green data center construction scheme has certain practical significance, in order to provide some reference for related research.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Using ARIMA and LSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the current stock market, fund companies and investment companies use a variety of quantitative strategies to make profitable investments and transactions. In order to construct a profitable quantitative strategy, it is necessary to predict the market price of stocks. Fund companies usually extract valuable information from investors’ comments on the stock on social media, the company’s financial statement data and the historical price of the stock to reasonably predict the future price of the stock and trade on this basis. However, it is difficult to make accurate prediction of the stock price, because the market price of the stock is not only affected by the behavior of investors, but also by changes in government policies, sudden international events such as COVID-19 and the War between Ukraine and Russia. Therefore, the stock market often fluctuates greatly. Linear models commonly used in other fields will not be suitable for predicting future stock market movements. In this paper, we will select Google’s historical data from 2016 to 2022, and use ARIMA model and MACHINE learning LSTM model widely used in quantitative trading to predict the stock price in the future.

articleTitle: Research on Financing Mode of New Agricultural Operators Under the Background of "Blockchain + Big Data"
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to financing difficulties, NABE are hard to make progress. The main reasons are the information asymmetry between the financing parties, the lack of effective collateral and their own limitations. This paper will innovate the traditional financing mode by using the characteristics of Blockchain that is not easy to tamper with and decentralized, as well as the powerful functions of data mining, analysis and processing of Big Data technology, so as to establish a trust mechanism to solve the financing problems of new agricultural financial entities.

articleTitle: Stock Price Prediction Based on Time Series Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to the nature of the stock market, we know that stocks fluctuate violently on a daily basis, not only affected by the market environment, but also by some political factors and natural disasters, therefore it is difficult to predict the rise and fall of stocks. I have been looking for a more accurate way to predict the changes of the stock market. In order to achieve the goal, I choose the optimal stock prediction method by comparing different prediction methods.In recent years, the quantitative investment has developed rapidly. Due to the stable performance of the quantitative investment trading strategy, its market scale and share are constantly expanding, which has been considered by more and more international investors.In the following article, I will use advanced models and machine learning algorithms to predict the rise and fall and the trend of MSFT stock price in the future which based on the data of MSFT stock price obtained in previous years. I mainly selected three models for comparison. GARCH family model, Auto ARIMA model and LSTM neural network model.I first process the data, remove the missing values and segment them. For GARCH, I use Eviews to model. When building the Auto ARIMA and LSTM model, I read the data into Python and segment the data. Next, I set the neuron points, iteratively train the data, and predict the trained data to fit the image. Finally, after comparison, I choose the LSTM model with better fitting degree to make prediction.

articleTitle: Analysis of Weibo User Characteristics and Emotional Tendency in COVID-19 Scenario Based on K-means Clustering Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: By analyzing Sina Weibo content helps to better guide internet public opinion. This paper selects the Weibo trending topic of '11.3 COVID-19 Epidemic in Dalian City' and uses K-means clustering algorithm to construct Weibo User Characteristics Model from three aspects: basic attributes, behavior attributes and value attributes. Then, based on the emotional dictionary, this paper also examines the emotional types of Weibo users and their dissemination trends. The study carries out that the user groups under this topic are mainly divided into hot spot generating users, high-frequency interactive users and ordinary social users. During the outbreak of the epidemic, Weibo users' emotions are mainly positive emotions of 'good' and 'happy', showing a trend from pessimistic to optimistic emotions.

articleTitle: Establishment and Evaluation of Measurement and Control System Model Based on Data Analysis Optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Data and analysis system is a system used by enterprises to manage data and analysis, which is of great significance in this era of big data. The more mature a D&A system is, the more a business can benefit from its database, and the more business advantage a business can gain. Based on the above situation, this paper analyzes and models the existing data. From the perspective of effective integration of port logistics system personnel, technology, process and data information, this paper selects several D&A system maturity evaluation indicators, such as process data information requirement consistency and task completion degree based on data information. The optimal solution linear model of personnel index, the optimization type selection model of technology evaluation level, and the comprehensive evaluation model are established respectively. The principal component analysis method, entropy weight method, improved tosis and other computational analysis methods are used to obtain the system maturity assessment and optimization system specific suggestions. Finally, this paper verifies the reliability of prediction and optimization of the existing measurement and control system, and verifies the advantages of the model, such as real rigor, high efficiency, evaluation stability and applicability.

articleTitle: The Status of the Legitimacy Principle in the Accounting Regulation System Based on the Big Data Background
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The principle of legality as the basic principle followed by China's accounting theory and legal provisions, in the background of the big data era, according to the trend of China's accounting reform and development, in-depth exploration of the basic meaning and important position of the principle of legality in the system of accounting laws and regulations, can provide innovative basis for the development of modern social economy. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the current situation of accounting and financial management under the background of big data, this paper studies the important position of the principle of legality in the system of accounting laws and regulations, and puts forward effective countermeasures for accounting legislation in the new era.

articleTitle: Governance Innovation Model of Social Enterprises Based on Structuration Theory: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Social enterprises aim at solving social problem and spurring innovation, is an important force to promote social development. This paper first expounds the background and definition of social enterprise, then according to action script analysis framework of the structuration theory, from dominance, legitimacy, competence three dimension to analyze some practical governance innovation models. Finally, choosing the CFPA Microfinance as a typical case to verify social enterprises can make appropriate management innovation model to sustain the balance of social objectives and economic benefits at the same time. This paper provides a certain theory and reference practice for the innovation and development of social enterprises in the E-commerce era.

articleTitle: Research on Macroeconomic Prediction Model Based on BP algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the development of modern economic construction, to better innovation countermeasures, steadily enhance the level of national economic development and science, macro-economic control and regulation to use grey forecasting early projections for the core of the macroeconomic indicators, and combined with artificial neural network prediction model of nonlinear and the accuracy of the rule of component. So in this paper, we study the system to know at present, China's macroeconomic forecasting model on the basis of the research status quo, based on grey prediction analysis, the main indicator of macroeconomic presented using artificial neural network self-study ability and adaptability, and eventually considering economic factors on the basis of effective processing input data, after using the improved BP algorithm to predict the macroeconomic development results. The experimental results of this research model prove that the macro-economic prediction model based on BP algorithm has application value.

articleTitle: An Empirical Analysis of the Cooperative Mechanism Between Modern Service Industry and Credit Environment in Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: On the basis of constructing the credit environment index system and the modern service industry index system, this paper uses the principal component analysis method to study the cooperative mechanism between the improvement of credit environment and the development of modern service industry in Guangdong Province. The results show that the first principal component of credit environment has a strong correlation with the first principal component of modern service industry; The correlation between the first principal component of credit environment and the second principal component of modern service industry is weak; The correlation between the second principal component of credit environment and the first principal component of modern service industry is not significant; There is a negative correlation between the second principal component of credit environment and the second principal component of modern service industry.

Author Keywords: the development of modern service industry

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Export Cross-border E-commerce Model Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The cross-border e-commerce platform is a global trade platform that is "free, open, universal and inclusive". On this platform, consumers all over the world can buy and SMEs can sell all over the world, which truly realizes the seamless link of globalization. In the new era, the cross-border e-commerce industry has developed rapidly. In order to promote the development of cross-border e-commerce industry, the original development model must be innovated and optimized, focusing on the optimization of various modules and work processes within the enterprise. Make e-commerce operation more efficient and purchase more convenient, so as to bring users a more convenient and pleasant shopping experience. Research and analyze the cross-border e-commerce business model, first calculate the evaluation results of business pattern innovation elements, and then explain the business pattern innovation under big data analysis technology through actual data. The utilization rate of enterprise resource allocation has increased by 18.47%, and the commercial values have effectively increased by about 27.94%. Therefore, the competitive advantage of e-commerce enterprises has been greatly enhanced.

articleTitle: Classroom Student Action Recognition Based on Dynamic Head
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Students' behavior reflects their status and the degree of participation in the classroom. Therefore, it is particularly crucial to use the classroom camera to automatically detect the student's behavior. However, there are situations where students are densely distributed and there are many small objects in the classroom. To solve this problem, the dynamic head was introduced to effectively detect student behavior. Firstly, we collect a large number of videos from real university classrooms for data annotation to form a student behavior dataset and treat student behavior recognition as an object detection task. Secondly, we propose a model called YOLOv5-Dy, which includes a dynamic head. The dynamic head includes scale, space, and task attention mechanisms, which focus on the importance of different features from different perspectives. Experimental results show that the improved model is more adaptable to the student behavior detection task. Finally, we compare our method with state-of-the-art detectors, and it turns out that the proposed approach performs better on the student behavior dataset.

articleTitle: Research on E-commerce Network Marketing Strategy Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of science and technology, e-commerce activities and marketing through the network under the condition of network technology provide a convenient way for enterprises to publicize their products and services, and have become an effective guarantee for enterprises to achieve success in future business competition. However, network marketing is a double-edged sword. There are both opportunities and challenges. In today’s information age, it is very necessary to study e-commerce and network marketing. This paper uses clustering and classification analysis algorithms of data mining to accurately predict and analyze the target customers of online marketing. The test results show that the prediction accuracy of attribute analysis tools of data mining is 20.36% higher than that of general analysis tools. Through in-depth analysis of these information, we can find market demand, customer groups with similar purchasing behavior and other information. Timely discovery of such information can help enterprises to quickly reflect market changes, make customer expectations, and thus formulate effective marketing plans.

articleTitle: A Expectation-Aware Dynamic Pricing Model for Spatial Crowdsourcing Platforms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Spatial crowdsourcing software are becoming indispensable to modern people’s lives. Among all topics over spatial crowdsourcing platforms, pricing method study is a fundamental one. The pricing strategy largely influences the incentives of workers and the revenue of platforms. The existing studies only consider the pricing strategy for users, but ignore the pricing to workers. They usually use a fixed percentage multiplied the price by to pay the workers given by users which neglect the status of the workers. However, the expectation price of the workers is also important. On one hand, if the payment to the workers is too high, the platform will reduce the revenue. On the other hand, if the payment to the workers is too low, the workers would reduce their enthusiasm to serve the spatial crowdsourcing tasks, leading to low quantity and quality of completed tasks. In order to balance the platform’s revenue and the worker’s enthusiasm, we propose a dynamic pricing method based on workers' expectation. Specifically, we consider three factors that may affect the worker’s pricing, which are the historical pricing law, the current working time of workers, and the price of the most recent orders. Through extensive experiments on real datasets, we show that our pricing method can improve both the revenue of the platforms and the ratio of completed orders, which means that it can well balance the interests of the platform and the interests of the workers.

articleTitle: Internet Finance Research Based on Blockchain Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of block-chain technology and the Internet finance industry, its risks have become more and more obvious, and will become an important factor restricting the development of Internet finance in the near future. Therefore, only by continuously strengthening the awareness of risk evolution and risk prevention, and thus effectively avoiding risks, can this problem be effectively solved. The purpose of this article is to study the risk evolution and prevention of Internet finance under block-chain technology. This article summarizes and summarizes the risk evolution process of Internet finance under block-chain technology, analyzes the actual situation of the current three stages of Internet finance development, and interprets the problems that exist in the current Internet finance development process through case analysis and the cause of formation is analyzed. This article puts forward suggestions on strengthening China's Internet financial risk prevention, in order to better improve and promote the effectiveness of Internet financial risk prevention. According to survey data, in 2015, my country's Internet transaction value reached 600 billion Yuan, and by 2020, the transaction value reached 65260 billion Yuan. It can be seen from this that in recent years, my country's Internet financial transaction volume has always maintained a rapid growth trend.

articleTitle: Risk Decision Model of Marketing Management Based on LINEST Function
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the increasingly fierce competition in the market economy environment, enterprise marketing management risk decision management has become more and more important. Generally, risk decision-making refers to how decision makers make optimal choices for multiple action plans when faced with multiple possible natural conditions. Therefore, if companies want to do a good job in marketing, they must make correct decisions based on scientific predictions. The purpose of this article is to study the marketing management risk decision model based on the LINEST function. This article uses the LINEST function in Excel to calculate the marketing management risk decision, which greatly simplifies the difficulty of the calculation, and briefly introduces the VaR model. Finally, a numerical model is used to verify the feasibility of the marketing management risk decision model based on the LINEST function. The experimental results show that the F value is 145.8, which is much larger than the F critical value (when the degree of freedom is 6 and the significance level is 0.075), which shows that the product There is no chance between the order quantity and the reward factor.

articleTitle: Research on Financial Early Warning of Chinese Listed Companies Based on Z-value Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper adopts z-value financial warning model, which has been widely used and recognized in recent years, as the research model. The selected z-value warning model includes Z-Score model, ZETA model and modified Z-Score model. Select the listed companies declared st in Shanghai and Shenzhen from 2018 to 2020 and non ST listed companies as the research samples. Study and evaluate the effectiveness and applicability of the three models in the financial early warning three years before being declared St. The results show that the modified Z-Score model has the best test effect on ST company among the three models, and the average prediction accuracy is 83.2% in the first three years of ST. However, the discrimination of non ST companies by this model is far inferior to that of ST companies. At present, if the modified Z-Score model is used to do financial early warning and forecast, auxiliary analysis means such as model index analysis and z-value volatility analysis are needed to improve the accuracy of identifying financial crisis companies.

articleTitle: Study on the Theoretical Model and Numerical Simulation Technology of Credit Derivatives Pricing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: To understand the reasons for the outbreak of the previous subprime mortgage crisis, it is found that the excessive trading of credit derivatives is the main factor causing the crisis, which can be divided into two situations, one is mortgage guaranteed securities (CDS), the other is credit default swaps (CDOs). Due to the leverage effect of credit derivatives, they can rapidly spread credit risks and directly limit the stability of financial market development. Therefore, at present, domestic and foreign researchers mainly discuss the risk measurement of credit derivatives. In this paper, the measurement of credit risk and the pricing model of credit derivatives are deeply discussed by using the method of random analysis, and the data of China's financial market are verified and analyzed. The final results show that the model and method are effective.

articleTitle: Research on Influencing Factors of Benign Development of Manufacturing in Guangdong Province under the Background of Digital Innovation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The manufacturing in Guangdong Province has a solid foundation for development. As China further accelerates the pace of reform and opening up, Guangdong Province has made remarkable achievements in manufacturing by virtue of its good location advantages and export-oriented economic characteristics. However, in the context of Global trade, the manufacturing problems with labor-intensive characteristics have gradually emerged. With the advent of the digital information age, the influence of digital economy on the development of manufacturing is more and more prominent. Advanced information technologies such as the Internet, artificial intelligence and big data are widely used in all aspects of enterprise production and operation. Digital innovation will become the key to the development of manufacturing in the future. Combined with the current situation of digital innovation development in Guangdong Province, this paper discusses the relationship between digital innovation and the benign development of manufacturing in Guangdong Province, and analyzes the influencing factors of benign development of manufacturing in Guangdong Province under the background of digital innovation, so as to provide reference for the realization of benign development of manufacturing in Guangdong Province.

articleTitle: Financial Early Warning System of Private Supermarket Based on Convolution Neural Network Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology and the current situation in the post-epidemic era, the economic situation of private supermarkets cannot be accurately forecasted. At the same time, because the financial situation of private supermarkets is affected by many factors, the early warning of financial situation is very difficult. Convolution neural network algorithm can process financial data, and by calculating the future trend, it can warn the financial situation in advance. In this paper, a financial early warning system of private supermarket based on convolution neural network algorithm is proposed, which is optimized by using bellwether algorithm. By investigating the financial data of six supermarkets in the past five years, it is verified that the early warning system can successfully predict the financial situation.

articleTitle: Financial Risks of M&A Restructuring of Digital Economy Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Due to the strong national support for the development of digital economy, the industrial scale of digital economy is gradually expanding and digital economy enterprises have fully developed. M&A restructuring is a common method for digital economy enterprises to expand their scale of company, but most of them are not completely successful. This paper adopts the F-score model and selects enterprises that have completed M&A restructuring in 2016 or 2017 for empirical analysis. It is found that the financial risk of enterprises significantly increases in the year after the completion of M&A restructuring, and the level of financial risk of enterprises decreases in the fourth year after the M&A, but it does not significantly improve in a short period of time.

articleTitle: The Empirical Research on the Impact of Technology Finance on Technology Enterprises in Guangdong Province
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper introduces the concept of technology finance and the combination of science and technology and finance in Guangdong Province, and based on the time series model of Eviews, this paper analyzes the impact of government oriented Technology Finance on technology enterprises in Guangdong Province in recent years, and then obtains the strategy of technology finance to support technology enterprises in Guangdong Province, so as to strengthen the support of technology finance to technology enterprises in Guangdong Province.

articleTitle: Data Cleaning and Data Analysis of Big Mart Data Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, I am committed to using machine learning to predict the sales of goods based on the sales data of stores. Among them, I firstly understand the meaning of the data set, trying to dig deeply to found out the hidden relationships that are significant for further exploration. Then, for missing value, I filled them with predicted values. As for the categories that can be optimized, I modified them in order to get more accuracy prediction. After that, I used 2 methods which are linear regression and random forest to predict the method and made a comparison between these two methods. Eventually, I used the better method to predict the coefficients of the data.

articleTitle: The Influence of Blockchain Technology on Cross-border E-commerce and Its Governance Path
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the development trend of economic globalization, the speed of information technology innovation of e-commerce is getting faster and faster. Cross-border e- commerce has gradually become an important link in the economic industry chain, but more problems have emerged in the new social environment. As a new content proposed by the innovation of The Times, blockchain technology has become the focus of cross-border e-commerce enterprises around the world and has a multi-faceted impact on the cross- border e-commerce industry. Based on the understanding of the current situation of cross-border e-commerce, this paper clarifies the application direction of blockchain technology in cross-border e-commerce according to the defining characteristics of blockchain technology, and puts forward effective governance countermeasures from the perspective of sustainable development.

articleTitle: Analysis of Factors Influencing People’s Mask Consumption Behaviors in COVID-19 Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under COVID-19, masks have become necessary for people's lives. Taking the mask market affected by the epidemic as an example, based on data mining, through questionnaire survey and research results, literature review, this paper discusses the mask consumption behaviour (MCB) and its influencing factors (IFs) under the COVID-19. MCB mainly through the following three aspects to describe the mask, including the amount of MCB (AMCB)and mask use frequency (MUF) and household mask Holdings (HMH), in the IFs of consumer's online preference for mask consumption (COP), consumer's offline preference for mask consumption (COFP), Wearing comfort of the mask (WCM), government's mask related policies (GMRP), Mask related crowd mind (MRCM), Enterprise's mask related policies (EMRP) and Mask Characteristics (MC) are studied. According to the results fitted by the data model, enterprises can refer to and optimize their marketing strategies, improve the problems existing in the mask sales strategy, and improve consumer satisfaction to promote the development of the mask market. The government can refer to and solve the potential problems.

articleTitle: Correlation Analysis of Public Welfare Activities and Brand Marketing Activities of Car Enterprises Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous popularization and development of the Internet, our life has been inseparable from the Internet, and the Internet marketing platform based on the Internet has also entered our life. In the commercial field, one of the changes brought by "big data" to the marketing activities of automobile enterprises is "Cloud marketing". "Cloud marketing" makes full use of various data information of the cloud computing platform to help enterprises formulate targeted marketing strategies by depicting, predicting, analyzing and guiding consumer behavior. Car enterprises should not only focus on the marketing level, but also on the strategic level when looking at public welfare marketing. As a part of the current marketing strategy of automobile enterprises, public welfare marketing has a profound impact on the construction of automobile enterprises' brand image and the promotion of their influence. The method used in this paper is cloud computing. It effectively integrates various online traditional resources into a huge computing and storage network through virtualization technology, providing users with convenient, fast and efficient services. After research, the research effect of this paper is remarkable, and it is suitable for extensive use.

articleTitle: A Stock Prediction Method Based on Fake Information Identification and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In this paper, we study a stock prediction method based on false information identification and machine learning.Firstly, a web crawler and the Tushare data interface tool are used. The textual data and stock price data required for the study are obtained. Next, the data is pre-processed such as tokenizing, stemming, etc. Next, the paper uses bag-of-words, POS tagging and word2vec methods for feature selection. The performance of various classifiers was compared, and the better performing logistic regression classifier was chosen to calculate the truth probability score and determine the true/false. Finally, two stock price prediction models, LSTM and GRU, are written and their prediction results are compared in real stock data. The prediction results of GUR were found to be more accurate and to fit better over time.

articleTitle: Financial Risk Crisis Early Warning System Based on K-means Clustering and SMOTE-CNN Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the guidance of China's economic policy, various industries in our country have made rapid development, but with the increasingly fierce competition among enterprises, enterprises are facing great risks, exposing the lack of early warning ability of financial risks. crisis awareness is not obvious and other problems. In order to study the financial crisis of the company, firstly, the samples are clustered by K-means clustering algorithm. According to the method of setting five clustering numbers first and then removing the extreme values, the clustering number is determined to be 3. Z-score standardization method is used to deal with the data, which makes the enterprise samples more comparable. After dividing different enterprise types, a crisis early warning system based on SOOTE-CNN model is constructed. After the completion of the construction, the experimental results are tested, and the simulation results show that the accuracy of the early warning model is about 97%, which has a good early warning effect.

articleTitle: Research on Load Aggregator Trading Strategy Based on Block Chains
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Block chains are characterized by distributed, highly redundant storage, time series data, non-tampering and forgery, decentralized credit, automated smart contracts, security and privacy protection. This makes block chains technology not only be successfully applied in the field of digital encrypted currency, but also in a wide range of economic, financial and social systems. Firstly, the transaction strategy of load aggregator in power retail market is introduced. Then, a new load aggregator trading scheme based on block chain technology is presented. Subsequently, simulation tests are carried out to verify that this method makes the transaction of load aggregator more efficient and economical.

articleTitle: Research on the Status of Trade Development in Hunan Province Based on Dynamic Factor Analysis and Orderly Sample Data Cluster Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The data of 14 cities in Hunan Province from 2010-2019 were selected, and the dynamic factor analysis method and ordered sample clustering were used to evaluate the influencing factors of domestic and foreign trade development in Hunan Province at both static and dynamic levels. The results show that: 1)the trade development kernel factor and foreign cooperation factor were the influential factors in the development of domestic and foreign trade of cities in Hunan Province. 2)From the comprehensive index of domestic and foreign trade development in Hunan Province, the level of domestic and foreign trade development in the eastern region and southern region of Hunan is generally better than other cities. In terms of the static indices of the two influencing factors, the trade development kernel factor index shows spatially uneven distribution characteristics, and the foreign trade cooperation factor index shows a gradient increasing pattern from north to south. 3)From the dynamic index of the factors of the development status of domestic and foreign trade in Hunan Province, the factors show fluctuating change characteristics over time. 4)In terms of the contribution rate of each influence factor, the primary factor driving the development of domestic and foreign trade in the eastern and southern region of Hunan Province, except Zhuzhou and Yongzhou, changes from the trade development kernel factor to the foreign cooperation factor. In the central and northern region of Hunan Province, the trade development of cities in the central region of Hunan Province has changed from being driven by the foreign cooperation factor to the core trade development factor. Finally, it puts forward targeted suggestions on the high-quality development of tourism in different types of tourist cities.

articleTitle: Study on Construction of Chinese Herbal Medicine Big Data Platform Based on Data Acquisition
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: At present, there are problems in information collection difficulties and information mismatch in the Chinese herbal medicine industry. This is mainly due to the lack of effective Chinese herbal medicine data collection mode to provide technical support to relevant enterprises. In this paper, two kinds of data collection modes, traceability mode and social mode, are proposed for the production and circulation of Chinese herbal medicines. Based on this, attracting agricultural enterprises, growers, primary processing enterprises, government sectors and finance institutions to take part in the Chinese herbal medicine big data platform. It is constructed to improve the quality of Chinese herbal medicines and create a complete ecosystem of Chinese herbal medicine industry.

articleTitle: Research on the Influence Mode of Automobile Customer Demand Based on Cloud Computing
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of globalization and the world economy, the competition among enterprises has become increasingly fierce, and customers' demands have become increasingly personalized and diversified. More and more enterprises have begun to adopt mass customization to provide products and services for customers. As a brand-new business model, cloud computing is profoundly affecting the whole IT (Information Technology) industry. With its own advantages, it can help enterprises to obtain high-performance IT services with the least IT investment. This paper studies how to select and distribute the key nodes in the cloud computing platform in mass customization in order to effectively deal with customer demand information, puts forward a customer demand response model for mass customization based on cloud computing, and proposes a key node determination algorithm with customer demand correlation as a measurement index.

articleTitle: Application of WeChat Public Platform Based on Big Data Analysis in Hospital Information Construction
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The public platform of WeChat relies on hundreds of millions of users of WeChat, which makes it more advantaged in promotion, and gradually breaks through the limitations of traditional medical care, touching and influencing related behaviors in the medical field. This paper studies the application of WeChat public platform based on BD(big data) analysis in hospital information construction. In this paper, the architecture of medical registration system is established, and a prescription recommendation method based on ontology-based rule reasoning is proposed. The knowledge summarized by clinical knowledge base is transformed into rules, and then the rules generated based on knowledge are applied to recommendation system. By analyzing the similarity of patients' condition, diseases and symptoms with known ontology, the appropriate prescription set is selected, and the case-based reasoning model based on the similarity of patients' ontology is constructed. The results show that the accuracy of prescription recommendation algorithm based on ontology rules in this paper is improved by 8.031% compared with the traditional collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm. Compared with the single-node algorithm, it has good scalability.

articleTitle: Design and Valuation of Weather Structured Financial Products
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As global climate risks intensify, frequent climate disasters will significantly impact industries such as agriculture, energy, transportation, and tourism, and it would be of positive relevance to design a type of weather index-linked structured financial product to meet the real needs of these industries. In this paper, a structured product linked to a weather index is designed. First, the weather data is modeled, and the parameters required for the product design are obtained; second, a pricing model is developed to price the structured product; and finally, the value sensitivity of the financial product is analyzed. The results show that the product's value is not sensitive to the risk-free rate of return but is more sensitive to volatility. At the same time, it is more sensitive to strike price and product maturity under certain conditions.

articleTitle: Data Mining and Analysis of Enterprise Management Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the era of big data, on the basis of paying attention to the management of data, enterprises begin to use data mining technology for secondary utilization of existing data information, which can not only get more information resources, but also bring more economic benefits for life and production. Some enterprises in order to improve its management efficiency, faster to adapt to the modern management environment, according to their own business needs to build a standardization business management system, but from the Angle of practice development, at present the business system can only carry on the simple transaction management, under the condition of enterprise management data continues to rise, the data of the business system is difficult to provide a deeper analysis and mining, It's getting harder and harder to extract more valuable information. Therefore, this paper studies data according to the enterprise management application, using data mining techniques to classify analysis as the core of management model, data mining in data mining analysis requirements, information characteristics, the decision tree algorithm on the basis of the decision tree algorithm is optimized to 4.5 C, empirical research mainly analyzes performance before and after optimization algorithm. The final results prove that the improved C 4.5 decision tree algorithm selects attribute standard optimization and user attention, which can make the actual data mining results meet the needs of enterprise management.

articleTitle: The Relationship between Institutional Investors, Securities margin trading, and Stock Price Collapse
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the strategic guidance of "unconventional development of institutional investors", institutional investors in China gradually show the characteristics of various and large scale. In 2010, China officially started margin trading business. The research sample of this paper covers the transaction data of all A-share listed companies from 2004 to 2016. The descriptive statistical analysis, correlation analysis, univariate analysis and other methods, multiple regression model and difference-in-difference model are used to empirically analyze the relation between institutional investors, margin trading and stock price crash risk. Based on results of the research, this paper argues that there are speculation and insider trading among institutional investors in China, which aggravates information asymmetry<sup>[1]</sup> and increases the risk of stock price collapse. Margin trading in China has obvious leverage effect<sup>[2]</sup>. Therefore, this paper puts forward policy suggestions: first, it is to strengthen the guidance and supervision of institutional investors, and standardize investment behavior; second, it is to perfect margin lending system, and improve governance effect.

articleTitle: Spatio-temporal Analysis of Urban Disaster Risk Based on Fourier Series Fitting and Characteristic Function Staining Analysis Method
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern society, disasters occur frequently, and urban disasters greatly threaten the safety of citizens. In order to build a smart city and ensure the safety of citizens to the greatest extent, it is necessary to analyze and predict disasters. In this paper, disasters are classified into seven categories, and correlation analysis is carried out from two aspects of time and space. Based on the historical disaster data, the series fitting model is used, and the regional disaster density in different regions is analyzed by the characteristic function staining analysis algorithm. At the same time, the relationship between disaster frequency and month is established, and the risk is divided from the perspective of time and space. The high law relationship between different types of disasters and time and the high correlation between some disasters in different regions are obtained. In order to prevent the occurrence of disasters and minimize losses, targeted measures can be taken in advance in high-incidence periods and regions.

articleTitle: Optimization of Neural Network and Data Mining Technology in Human Resource Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous progress of science and technology, many enterprises currently use information technology to optimize human resources. Data mining technology can collect and mine information in data, and neural network and deep learning technology can process, extract and predict data. This paper proposes a human resource model based on neural network technology and data mining technology, and optimizes the regression algorithm in human resource management. This paper selects the professional title, gender, education, and age in the sample as independent variables for verification. The results show that The model can predict the future development of enterprise human resources.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Influencing Factors of Enterprise Loss of R&D personnel Based on Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Science and technology enterprises are those that specialize in knowledge production or are dominated by knowledge production. The essential characteristics of enterprises determine their dependence on human resources. However, the loss of R&D personnel in science and technology enterprises in China is quite serious. This paper studies the influencing factors of R&D staff turnover in enterprises based on BD(big data) analysis, and the classification model of R&D staff turnover in science and technology enterprises based on BD. We propose to add a "post weight" index to C4.5 algorithm, in order to improve the deficiency of C4.5 algorithm in improving the attributes with more values. The results show that, in terms of transaction dimension, the impact on the turnover of technical R&D personnel in science and technology enterprises is not significant, but the main impact is caused by salary and performance appraisal. Cox model, C4.5 algorithm and improved DT(Decision tree) algorithm are used for running comparison. The total running time of the improved DT algorithm is 13.41% higher than that of Cox model and 22.08% higher than that of C4.5 algorithm. From these data, it can be seen that the classification speed of the improved DT algorithm is obviously improved.

articleTitle: Scientific and Technological Innovation, Government Expenditure and Digital Economy Promotion
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The degree of science - technical innovation has helped the advancement of the digital economy to some extent, and it has emerged as a new economic form that is flourishing in China. This article builds a theoretical framework of science - technical innovation, government spending, and the digital economy, verifies the mechanisms of the three, and utilizes pertinent data from 282 prefecture level cities in China from 2011 to 2019 to present the intermediate impact model. The study reveals that: (1) government spending and technological innovation play a significant role in promoting the advancement of the digital economy; (2) as an intermediary variable, government spending serves as an important conduit for the transmission of technological innovation's effects; and (3) the effect of these factors on the industrial structure. (4) The impact of science - technical innovation on the advancement of the digital economy is regionally heterogeneous.

articleTitle: Construction of Medical Archives Information Management System Based on Health Medical Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of social economy and the gradual improvement of people's living standards, people begin to attach great importance to their own health problems. The pursuit of a healthy life has changed dramatically from the previous treatment of diseases to the current disease free prevention. As the content of regional medical information sharing, the system construction of health archives for its security issues is in full swing, but repeated research and construction greatly waste resources and raise costs, so it is necessary to introduce domain analysis methods to reduce duplication and reduce costs. It does not simply input the contents of the paper medical records into the computer, but also records every bit of health related information in residents' daily life. Doctors can extract relevant information anytime and anywhere to quickly and comprehensively understand the situation. The retrieval is more convenient. Based on the existing research results, using the theories and methods of information ecology, from the perspective of system theory, taking the balance and sustainable development of the ecosystem as the foothold, this paper deeply studies the basic operating mechanism of the health file information ecosystem, discovers the rules from it, and provides reference for the management of the health file information system and the healthy and sustainable development of China's national health system project.

articleTitle: Research on Raw Material Ordering Model and Transportation Scheme Based on Linear Planning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper mainly focuses on the ordering and transportation of raw materials of a production enterprise. The linear programming model is established to optimize the ordering and transportation plan under the problem, which can help the production enterprise to order and transport the raw materials better. This paper first defines the characteristics of suppliers, through analysis and calculation and arrangement is divided into three parts: credit index, create value and supply, and by using the entropy weight method three indices’ weights assignment, into the equation of grey association analysis, it is concluded that the grey relation analysis as its importance score, then descending order, it is concluded that the top 50 most important suppliers. In this paper, the problems studied were decomposed into three sub-questions, and models were established to solve them respectively. For solving the minimum supplier, 0-1 variable was introduced to represent supplier selection, and the minimum supplier was the objective function, which could be expressed as:$\min \sum\limits_{i = 1}^{50} {{y_i}} $ To choose the best scheme, the use of SPSS for time series analysis, for problem 1 choose the importance of the top 50 suppliers to predict future supply 24 weeks, in order to forecast and need to complete orders index as a constraint, and the most economic optimization model is established based on this, the objective function of the model can be represented as:$\min 1.2 \cdot \sum\limits_{i = 1}^{50} {{x_{i1}}} + 1.1 \cdot \sum\limits_{i = 1}^{50} {{x_{i2}}} + \sum\limits_{i = 1}^{50} {{x_{i3}}} $ For the third sub-question, as for the second sub-question, SPSS was used for time series analysis to obtain the loss rate prediction of the transporter in the next 24 weeks. The minimum loss was taken as the objective function, which can be expressed as:$\min \sum\limits_{i = 1}^8 {\sum\limits_{j = 1}^3 {{m_i} \cdot {z_{ij}}} } $ After solving problem 2, the optimal ordering and transportation scheme is obtained. According to the analysis, the most economical optimization model calculates that the total cost consumption in the next 24 weeks will be 19173 units less than before, and the loss will be 19.1% less than before.

articleTitle: The Consumption of Health Products and Its Influencing Factors by Big Data Analysis Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The purpose of this paper is to use the methods of big data analysis algorithms and questionnaire surveys to analyze Chinese consumption of health products (HPC) and their influencing factors. From the literature review, questionnaire survey, and statistical results, 63.01% of them often know about health products (HP), the average frequency is 3.44, and the total amount is RMB 17407.54. The willingness of HPC (WHPC) is significantly and positively correlated with the cognition of product characteristics (PCC) and product advantages (PAC), and the frequency of HPC (FHPC) is significantly and positively correlated with the cognition of product characteristics (PCC). In contrast, the amount of HPC (AHPC) was significantly and negatively correlated with the cognition of people industrial (PIC). The cognition of product characteristics (PCC), education (EDU), and gender (GEN) significantly affect the willingness of HPC (WHPC), age significantly affects the frequence of HPC (FHPC), and monthly income (MI) significantly affects the amount of HPC (AHPC).

articleTitle: Mean-Var Multi-Stage Portfolio Model Based on Simulated Annealing Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Simulated annealing algorithm is derived from the process of crystal cooling. If the solid is heated and then cooled, regular crystals with high density and low energy can be formed, which corresponds to the global optimal solution in the algorithm. This algorithm has the advantages of simple calculation process, strong robustness and suitable for solving complex nonlinear optimization problems. Based on a series of practical constraints, this paper constructs a finite short selling mean var multi-stage portfolio optimization model, and uses this model to obtain the optimal investment strategy of assets in each stage under different paths. Through empirical research, this paper finds that the prediction results of the model are in line with the actual investment behavior of investors, which shows that the model proposed in this paper is reasonable.

articleTitle: Research on the Pricing Strategy of Stock-linked Structured Financial Products Based on Cholesky Decomposition and Monte Carlo Simulation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Taking multi-stock-linked structured financial products as the research object, this paper uses Cholesky decomposition method and Monte Carlo simulation method to make theoretical analysis and pricing research on stock structured financial products with complex income design terms. Select a 6-month stock-linked structured financial product issued by HSBC to carry out an empirical analysis on the pricing of the product, so as to show the application of Cholesky decomposition combined with Monte Carlo simulation pricing method in multi-asset structured financial products. The research results show that Cholesky decomposition combined with Monte Carlo simulation pricing method is more suitable for the pricing of multi-stock-linked financial products whose asset prices follow a normal distribution; Empirical analysis finds that the pricing of HSBC's financial products is high and the actual rate of return is low.

articleTitle: Stock Market Predictions Based on Time Series Prophet
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Predicting the accurate stock price and variation trends is crucial for companies and individuals before purchasing the stock. With the algorithm's accurate predictions, it could offer precious suggestions for the buyers and help them to choose the best stock in the market to avoid potential risks. This paper recorded the experiment carried out for predicting the trends of Tesla from 2017 to 2018 and then compared the result with actual trends. This paper also compares the accuracy of different algorithms, including linear regression and KNN (K-Nearest Neighbors) etc. This paper aims to demonstrate the detailed process of predicting a stock in the stock market covering from acquiring data, washing data and most importantly using multiple algorithms to analyze the data and generate a final prediction.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization Control of Industrial and Commercial Enterprise Management Process Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Enterprise industrial and commercial management is a management activity carried out within an enterprise, while administrative industrial and commercial management is the management carried out by industrial and commercial departments. These are two completely different concepts. It contains many aspects, which need the attention of enterprise managers. Based on big data, this paper studies the management process of industrial and commercial enterprises, and optimizes and controls it. The research shows the application experience and rules of big data in industrial and commercial management. Combined with advanced big data processing technology and industrial and commercial management theory at home and abroad, the existing industrial and commercial management schemes and various cost accounting indicators of enterprises are upgraded and revised. At present, the emergence of big data information poses new challenges and requirements to the management mode of industrial and commercial enterprises. Under different modes of production and management, enterprise managers are required not only to expand the cost dimension and vision, but also to improve the scientificity and rationality of budget control by building an economic budget control center and an evaluation mechanism of economic budget results, which will promote the realization and promotion of market economic value for enterprises.

articleTitle: Research on Information Science Knowledge Network and Its Evolution Trend Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the development of network technology, with big data technology as the core information science presents the development trend of the interdisciplinary and multidimensional, practical work are also put forward more research topic, actively looking for information science disciplines of potential partners, clear the subject structure and evolution trend of the theme of the help scholars more quickly master the development of the discipline of frontier and hot, It provides effective basis for decision-makers and managers of scientific research. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the structure and development trend of information science discipline, this paper takes knowledge network as the core, deeply discusses the corresponding structure and evolution trend, and divides information science discipline into eight categories for empirical analysis. The final results show that this research can grasp the research trend of subject topic in a certain sense, and has a positive influence on improving the research method of subject knowledge network.

articleTitle: Towards the Era of Intelligence: How does Artificial Intelligence (AI) Enable China’s Export Competitiveness?
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on Tianyancha’s data and the provincial macro data in China’s statistical yearbook from 2005 to 2017, we investigate the impact of Artificial intelligence (AI) on export competitiveness by using the two-way fixed effect model and SYS-GMM intermediary test method. From the perspectives of labor cost and R & D innovation, the potential mechanism of AI on export competitiveness is also captured. Furthermore, contrary to the inland and western areas, the effects of AI on export competitiveness are found more obvious in the coastal, central and eastern areas. Our research has important guiding significance for the intelligent transformation of China’s industry and improving the quality of export products.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Construction of Intelligent Laboratory Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: At present, most colleges and universities in China have entered the development stage of intelligent campus. The laboratory plays an important role in school management. Therefore, comprehensive consideration should be given to the construction of intelligent laboratory management platform. This paper analyzes the current problems existing in laboratory management in most colleges and universities, as well as the characteristics of building smart laboratories in colleges and universities, as well as how to establish smart laboratory management systems in colleges and universities, in order to improve the intelligent level of laboratory management in colleges and universities and make their laboratory management more scientific and comprehensive.

articleTitle: Economic Development Strategy of Power Grid Enterprise Development Platform Based on SWOT Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid growth of Internet data resources and significant progress of big data analysis technology, platform economy has become an important part of domestic and foreign economic development and an important means of competition for modern enterprise development. How to combine the advantages of traditional platforms with modern Internet technology to realize the new development of power grid enterprises is an urgent problem to be solved at present. After clarifying the connotation and characteristics of the platform economy, the SWOT analysis model is used to analyze the development environment of the platform economy of power grid enterprises, and the countermeasures are put forward.

articleTitle: Railway Logistics Alliance Revenue Distribution Based on Improved Shapley Value
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Railway Logistics Alliance is an innovative development model of railway logistics enterprises. To ensure that the Railway Logistics Alliance can maintain long-term operation, the key is to solve the problem of income distribution within the alliance. Considering that there is excessively considered fairness and dispensing in the current income distribution method, three differences between government railway freight enterprises and private logistics enterprises are analyzed by examples: the operating costs of logistics enterprises, customer satisfaction coefficients, and undertake default The risk factor is made by improving the difference between the Shapley value method and the hierarchical method, which has been corrected to the production of the railway logistics enterprises and the two private logistics enterprises in the railway logistics, and finally compare the Shapley value of the improvement. Distribution plan, found that the revenue of government railway freight companies has increased by 916,960 yuan, while the private logistics enterprises A revenue decreased by 904,250 yuan, and the B returns of logistics enterprises were less than 12,710 yuan.

articleTitle: A Financial Forecast Method Based on Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Stock forecast refers to the prediction of the future development direction and the rise and fall of the stock market by securities analysts who are familiar with the stock market according to the development of the stock market. This prediction behavior is only based on the factor assumption as a given precondition. Machine learning is more popular than ever. It is widely used for data based decision-making and investment. As long as you search "machine learning" and "stock prediction" on Google at the same time, you will get rich content about time series prediction and recurrent neural network. Although stock prices are a good data choice for such algorithms, caution should be exercised, especially when funds are involved. Predicting changes in the stock market has always been one of the most challenging things. Various factors involved in this prediction. All these factors make stock prices volatile and difficult to predict accurately. The systematic risk and unsystematic risk of stock investment are complex, and it is difficult to extract and analyze the quantitative relationship between various influencing factors, which makes the prediction results of traditional methods often unsatisfactory. Therefore, it is very important to find an effective inventory forecasting method. In this study, various mathematical theories and data mining techniques are applied to the stock analysis software, and through the study of historical trading data, the trend law of stocks is obtained. Through machine learning, we can continuously learn and optimize the data in the process of application, and improve the prediction model to successfully predict the stock increase, and then achieve the goal of profitability.

articleTitle: Research on Economic and Financial Risk Early Warning Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the rapid development of modern enterprise economy, in the face of the development trend of economic globalization, enterprises are bound to deal with diversified financial risks. If economic and financial risks are not found in time and effective measures are taken, then enterprises are likely to fall into financial crisis and directly limit their long-term construction and development. Especially for listed companies, how to use artificial intelligence algorithm to effectively prevent and control economic and financial risks is a hot issue explored by modern financial theory and practice. Therefore, on the basis of understanding the concept of financial risk, this paper studies the importance of economic and financial risk early warning according to the current situation of financial risk of listed enterprises in China, so as to effectively apply the Bayesian network after building an operating system with early warning model as the core. The empirical results show that the economic and financial risk early warning system based on Bayesian network is effective.

articleTitle: Cloud Storage Data Integrity Verification Scheme that Users Can Revoke in Real Time
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the evolution of cloud storage and the limitations of traditional storage methods, more and more enterprises choose to store data on cloud servers to decrease local storage and maintenance overhead. However, when data is stored on the cloud, no copy is stored locally, so how to ensure the integrity of information on the cloud is significant research topic. In order to efficiently resolve the problem a cloud storage data integrity verification scheme that can be revoked in real time by users is proposed. This paper introduce a trusted third-party proxy to the traditional proxy re-signature technology to complete the re-signature of the data in the cloud for the new user, so as to avoid the untrusted cloud server leaking the signature and damaging the data integrity; Distribute an administrator attribute for users, so that users can revoke in real time according to their actual tenure; Finally, a random mask is used in the audit challenge, which effectively prevents curious third-party audits from recovering and revealing the original data by verifying the information. Security analysis and performance analysis demonstrate that the scheme is secure and effective.

articleTitle: Research on Cross Species Statistical Arbitrage Based on Python
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Python is widely used in many fields because of its excellent simplicity, readability and scalability. In the field of edible oil, soybean oil and palm oil have great substitutability in the field of consumption, so there is a strong correlation between prices. When the price difference between the two deviates from a certain level, there is an opportunity for cross species arbitrage. Through the correlation analysis and cointegration analysis of the closing prices of futures contracts, the arbitrage position, arbitrage range and stop loss range are determined. Next, using the real data for one and a half years, this paper compiles python code to realize simulated transactions. The simulation results show that the return is 76.5%. It fully demonstrates the power of python and this strategy has good feasibility.

articleTitle: The Spatio-temporal Evolution and Driving Factors of County Economic Difference in Lanzhou-Xining Urban Agglomeration Based on ESDA Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Taking the Lanzhou-Xining urban agglomeration (here in after referred to as Lanxi urban agglomeration) as the research object, the study used the per capita GDP (abbreviated pcGDP) data of the counties with the methods of traditional mathematical analysis and ESDA, to analyze the pattern evolution characteristics of county economic in the region from the space-time dimension from 2010 to 2018, and using the multivariate regression model and GWR model to analyze the driving factors. The results show: The absolute difference of county economy in the Lanxi urban agglomeration has widened year by year, while the relative difference has developed in a "U" type, and the polarization phenomenon is relatively prominent; the spatiotemporal differentiation is obvious, and the spatial structure is a typical "core-edge" structure; the county economic pattern has obvious space-time correlation characteristics--positive spatial correlation , and which continues to increase over time. The hot spot high-value cluster areas of the county economy are mainly concentrated in the core areas of economic development, and the cold spot low-value cluster areas are mainly in the peripheral counties; The economic differences among counties are affected by many factors. Among consumption level, industrialization level and investment level are the main factors, and the influence effects of each factor are spatially different.

articleTitle: Analysis and Optimization of Communication Strategy of New Energy Vehicles at Home and Abroad Based on Data Mining
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: More and more new energy vehicles have entered people's vision. The new energy vehicle industry has experienced a process from germination to rapid development in a short period of time. From the international comparison of new energy vehicle technology and industrialization level, China's new energy bus technology industrialization scale ranks first in the world. It covers a variety of technical routes such as plug-in, incremental, and pure electric, as well as a variety of energy supply methods such as slow charging, fast charging, battery replacement, online charging, and dual source fast charging. In this paper, based on the DM(data mining) based communication of new energy vehicles at home and abroad, relevant research has been carried out. With regard to the satisfaction degree of charging equipment, the median is 17, the mode is 17, and the average is 19.93. The overall distribution of samples is relatively centralized, which also shows that people are basically satisfied with the charging equipment, but they think that there is also a lot of room for improvement. As one of the most successful cases in the field of new energy vehicles, new energy vehicles provide a lot of development experience. At the moment when DM technology is increasingly prosperous, the integration and interaction between the new energy vehicle industry and DM will contribute to a more rapid and healthy development of new energy vehicles at home and abroad.

articleTitle: Topology Relationship Identification Based on TDA
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
