abstract: The traditional low voltage power grid topology on-site checking or outage screening method is no longer applicable for the development of smart grid. It is necessary to find an effective remote topological relationship identification method based on power data analysis. This paper presents a topological membership identification method based on intelligent measurement data and Trigonometric Decomposition Algorithm (TDA). The method firstly builds a topological membership model of low voltage power grid based on the current effective value data measured synchronically and the law of flow conservation, then uses TDA to solve the model. TDA gives three corresponding algorithms according to different application scenarios. After that, threshold values are set to discriminate the membership relations of the three algorithms. The majority principle determines the final membership relations. The practical results show that the TDA still has high accuracy when only the current data is needed without other detailed topological parameters, and the accuracy of TDA can be improved by setting the threshold checking.

articleTitle: Impact of Industrial Internet Development on China's Urban Economy - Based on DID Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the panel data of 82 cities in China from 2015 to 2019, DID mod was used to analyze the impact of industrial Internet development on China's urban economy. It is found that industrial Internet development significantly enhances urban economic development, and the conclusion still holds after robustness testing. Based on this paper, targeted policy recommendations are made for the vigorous development of the Industrial Internet and the stable expansion of urban economic volume.

articleTitle: Evaluation of Aviation Support Equipment use Efficiency Based on Negative Impact
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In view of the current situation that the use data statistics of aviation support equipment are difficult, the use evaluation methods are lack, and the users pay more attention to the "bad" equipment, this paper establishes the use efficiency evaluation index system of aviation support equipment by analyzing the three dimensions of product quality, supplier after-sales service quality and product use convenience of aviation support equipment. Based on the evaluation of many experts in the industry, the weights of primary and secondary indicators are determined by analytic hierarchy process (AHP). Starting from the negative impact of the user unit, evaluate the "bad" support equipment and put forward suggestions for rectification. A case study of one support equipment is carried out by data analysis. The verification results show that the established index evaluation system has good operability and practicability.

articleTitle: Performance Management of Middle-level Managers in Chinese Education System Based on Competency Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Middle-level managers are in the connecting position in Chinese education system, they connect teachers and students. Improving their competency and professionalism can improve the overall working level of the educational management team in universities. Based on the competency theory, this study uses behavioral event interview method to obtain interview data and coding to extract competency characteristics of middle-level managers in universities to establish a competency model. The model includes four dimensions, namely, achievement characteristics, management characteristics, personal qualities, and personality traits, and includes a total of 10 competency characteristics. The survey on the professional development of middle-level managers in universities shows that this group has a high level of education but a low sense of achievement, and the assessment and incentive mechanisms do not work well. Based on the competency model, this study initially designed the performance evaluation index system for middle-level managers. By analyzing the relationship between competency and middle-level managers' performance and the job characteristics of them, the advantages of competency-based performance management of middle managers in universities are proposed and the performance management model is established.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Digital Financial Inclusion on Urban-rural Residents’ Consumption Gap Based on an Econometric Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Using a static panel analysis model, a logistic regression model, and a dynamic panel analysis model, respectively, the related relationship between the digital financial inclusion index and the urban-rural residential consumption gap is investigated based on the provincial panel data of 31 provinces (autonomous regions) in China from 2015 to 2019. It is found by the study that the increase in digital financial inclusion index significantly contributes to bridging of the urban-rural residential consumption gap, despite heteroskedasticity and endogeneity. Meanwhile, the increase of urbanization rate and the positive government intervention also contribute to the reduction of this gap, while the upgrade of industrial structure and the expansion of economic openness will hinder the reduction of this gap but the results are not significant. The findings of the study provide a reasonable path to effectively alleviate the Chinese urban-rural residents’ consumption gap, and lay a theoretical foundation for further solving the real problem of urban-rural unbalanced development.

articleTitle: Research on Product Sales of Pacific Precision Forging Technology Co Based on Gray GM (1,1) Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the impact of international relations between Russia and Ukraine and the limitation caused by the continued development of COVID-19 on international imports and exports, the supply chain of various industries around the world has been hit hard, especially the automotive industry. This paper takes Pacific Precision Forging Technology Co., Ltd, a leading company in the auto parts industry, as the main subject of the study, and examines the whole industry through this company. By using SWOT analysis, we understand the characteristics of the research subject, and adopt the gray GM(1,1) model to forecast the sales volume of its products, so as to provide effective forecasting for parts suppliers to enhance foresight and strengthen anti-risk efforts, thus making the suppliers more competitive in the market.

articleTitle: To Find out High-Profit Zone From Industrial Value Chain Perspective in Big Data Era : Real Estate Sector as Case Study
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the 21th century, economic competition takes place neither at corporate nor commercial mode level. Martin Christopher points out that the competition in the 21th century is not among enterprises, but between the supply chains behind each enterprise. An enterprise establishes an industrial value chain and competes against its counterpart who has its own industrial value chain. Also big data can offer new processing mode to generate decision making power, insight and discovery. For a good company, its assets and scale of operation should not be inevitable indicators because assets are bygone accumulation and profits serve as interim management performance. Future treasure can only be reflected by the value chain. Only under the guidance of value chain top-level design,together with mathematical modeling can a company finds out its high profit zone. And this shows that the company conducts strategic management in time-based competition stage.

articleTitle: The Impact of Commercial Insurance on Household Risk Financial Asset Allocation-Study Based on CHFS Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the residential household financial market and the strengthening of people's risk awareness, people's willingness to participate in risky financial asset allocation has gradually increased. At the same time, commercial insurance in China has developed rapidly in recent years and has great potential for development. Based on data from the China Household Financial Survey Project (CHFS) 2019, this paper explores the impact of commercial insurance on households' allocation of risky financial assets. By building a logit model for empirical analysis, the study finds that households who purchase commercial insurance are more likely to allocate risky financial assets, and at the same time, based on the findings of this study, this paper puts forward relevant suggestions from both the government, commercial insurance institutions and households themselves Based on the findings of this study, this paper proposes recommendations to promote the development of commercial insurance in the household financial market.

articleTitle: Domestic Study on Digital Economy, Industrial Upgrading and Economic Development
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The digital economy is in full swing and has become a new path for economic growth, with the role of the digital economy radiating more and more widely and with greater and greater influence, and which is an important cornerstone for promoting the "Digital China" strategy, and an increasingly important driver and new path for global economic recovery and social progress. Based on relevant domestic research results, this paper collates the connections among digital economy, industrial development and economic growth, and further points out the breakthrough points for future research.

articleTitle: Stakeholder Relationship Modeling Based on Value Exchange for Electric Vehicle Development Project
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Understanding the relationships between stakeholders is critical to project success. This paper introduces value exchange concept from social exchange theory and investigates its application in stakeholder relationship modeling for Electric Vehicle (EV) development project. Firstly, identify stakeholders of the EV development project. Secondly, use an improved value flow identification template to identify the needs and value flows of stakeholders, classify those value flows, and then build a stakeholder relationship network. Finally, analyze the value path and value cycle based on the relationship network, and discuss the advantages of the research in four aspects including indirect relationship analysis. The research can provide supports for project stakeholder relationship modeling and requirements understanding.

articleTitle: Research on the Impact of Investor Sentiment, Systematic Risk on Bank Stock Prices<sub-title>Empirical Study Based on VAR and Impulse Response Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This paper examines the impact of investor sentiment and systematic risk on bank stock prices in China through VAR and impulse response function by selecting indicator data reflecting investor sentiment and systematic risk from January 2011 to December 2020 in the context of behavioral finance perspective. It is found that: firstly, both investor sentiment and systematic risk have a significant positive impact on bank stock prices, however, sharp fluctuations in systematic risk can trigger panic and bring down stock prices. Second, investors can become overly optimistic about the climb in stock prices in the short term, while in the long term this sentiment is reversed, bringing stock prices back to stable levels. Based on the research results, this paper gives policy suggestions that government should strengthen expectation management and introduce investors for banks appropriately.

articleTitle: Credit Risk Assessment Model of Technology-based SMEs With Heterogeneous Ensemble Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, with the rapid development of technology-based SMEs, their credit business has increasingly attracted the attention of commercial banks. How to promote the credit business of technology-based SMEs while strengthening risk prevention is an urgent problem to be solved, but the current risk assessment models have some shortcomings. To solve this problem, this paper proposes a credit risk assessment model for SMEs based on heterogeneous ensemble learning algorithm. Firstly, this paper constructs a risk assessment system based on multi feature analysis, establishes a nebulous integrated appraisal model of credit risk based on non-financial indicators, and obtains the credit risk rating of enterprises. On this basis, BP neural network, support vector machine and random forest algorithm are used to build three enterprise default risk prediction models respectively, and then three classifiers are integrated based on stacking strategy to construct a SME default risk identification model integrating financial indicators and non-financial indicators. The model can better identify the default risk of SMEs and has strong adaptability, So as to achieve the purpose of preventing credit risk.

articleTitle: The Forest Management Optimization Model Based On The Variation Of Trees’ Age Structure
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In order to maximize the comprehensive value of forests for human-beings, our team developed a method to acquire an optimized forest management plan, which not only consider the carbon sequestration of the forest, but also balances various needs of society. In this paper, we first consider the influence of our management plan on forest carbon sequestration. We divide the carbon sequestration into two parts: the trees in the forests and the existing wood product made from the forest. To predict the carbon sequestration in trees over time, we need the current carbon sequestration of forest, the age structure and scale of the forest over time and the carbon sequestration in trees as it grows. First, we use Lasso Regression to determine the significant forest characteristics, then we use Multiple Linear Regression Model to analyze how forests' characteristics affect current carbon sequestration. Then, we use improved Leslie Model to predict the variation of age structure and scale of the forest with the application of management plan. Then we use the improved exponential model to describe the variation of carbon sequestration as a tree grows. To predict the carbon sequestration in wood product over time, we calculate the amount of wood each time we harvest and establish a model describing how wood products are made and decay. Then we set the mean value of the total carbon sequestration over time as the optimization objective, the parameters in forest management plans as decision variables to establish a single-objective optimization problem. We give reasonable intervals to the variables and determine the optimized forest management plan through Grid Search Method and Monte Carlo Method. Second, we consider the influence of forest management plan on other aspects of the society. By using AHP, we set the weight of forests’ value in various aspects and by using TOPSIS Model, we established a model to evaluate the comprehensive value of forests. Then we set forest’s mean scores from TOPSIS over time as the optimization objective, the parameters in forest management plans as decision variables to establish an optimization problem. Computer simulation can be used to get an optimized management plan. Furthermore, we discussed the traits of the forests in which managements are suitable, and the transition strategy in management plans. Also, by System Hierarchy Clustering we classified all the management plans into 3 types which apply to different situations.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Research on the Lag of Market Integration on the Integration of Informatization and Industrialization
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Based on the great unification of the domestic market and the vigorous implementation of the policy of promoting the integration of informatization and industrialization, this paper studies the influence of market integration on the integration of informatization and industrialization, Construct the theoretical model of market integration to the integration of information and industrialization. Three panel regression models and lag research models are used to prove that market integration has a positive impact on the integration of informatization and industrialization, and has a lag. Further study found that the urbanization rate, the number of invention patent accounted for and the local tech spending accounted for all positive impact on informatization and industrialization fusion, also still has a certain lag, because of the above conclusion put forward the corresponding advice: expanding the western market, the government to optimize the allocation of resources and further enhance the independent research and development ability.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of New Smart City Based on Big Data Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Under the background of the continuous development of high-tech information technology and the continuous improvement of science and technology level, cities should constantly improve their intelligence and informatization level, and integrate them into a complete system, as they undertake the functions of promoting economic development and developing society. In December 2018, the State Council released the 13th Five-Year National Informatization Plan, and deployed a new smart city construction campaign. As far as smart cities are concerned, the Internet of Things and cloud computing are the core technologies of construction, and their own advantages make them the inevitable outcome of the future development. Therefore, this paper mainly describes the application research based on the key technologies of smart city construction, and mainly makes a more in-depth analysis of each core technology in the construction process, so as to provide reference for relevant personnel. The article analyzes the important value of big data in the construction of smart cities, and puts forward suggestions for the construction of smart cities in the context of big data, with a view to providing a strong reference for China's urban development and smart city construction.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of Government Social Administration Efficiency under the COVID-19 Pandemic : Based on Big Data Analytics
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the global spread of COVID-19, the social economy has been affected to different degrees. Using the survey data to calculate the residents’ perception of the government’ s administrative management efficiency in the epidemic situation, the influencing factors of the government’ s administrative management efficiency are studied. Selecting the government management effect, the type of administrative level and residents’ response, using statistical methods to quantify the indicators. By analyzing the individual characteristics of residents, the differences in their perception of the government were deeply explored. At present, the epidemic situation around the world is still broken out in parts, and the epidemic in China has entered the stage of normalized prevention and control. The research results can provide reference for the government to improve its work efficiency, build a harmonious relationship with the people, and truly play the government’ s functions for the people.

articleTitle: Study on the Relationship between Talent Flow and Innovation in Chinese Internet Enterprises Based on Social Network Theory
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Nowadays, the knowledge-based economy prevails. Mass entrepreneurship and innovation play a leading role in the development of the new era. For Chinese Internet enterprises, the core competitiveness formed based on innovation is difficult to imitate and can beat most competitors in the industry. From the perspective of talent flow, this paper explores the impact of talent flow on the innovation performance among Internet enterprises based on the social network theory. This paper constructs the human capital social network for Internet enterprises based on the information of resumes of talents from professional social network platform, and studies the effect of the position of human capital social network for Chinese Internet enterprises on their innovation performance. The empirical results show that: The degree centrality and structural hole of human capital social network are positively correlated with the innovation performance of Chinese Internet enterprises.

articleTitle: Forest Health Evaluation Based on Big Data Analysis and Multi-source Forest Factors: A Case Study of the Democratic People's Republic of China
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, the massive trades between China and its neighboring countries have promoted the development of forestry and economic reforms in many countries, but have also posed a certain threat to forest health, which brought further attention to forest health in the border. This paper takes the cross-border between China, Democratic People's Republic of Korea (DPRK)and Russia as the research object. Based on multi-source remote sensing data, we collected forest resource survey data in 2000, 2010, and 2020, and use a combination of analytic hierarchy process and entropy method to determine the index weight and evaluate forest health status. As a result, most of the forest health is in the sub-healthy and moderate health range. The extremely unhealthy forests show a downward trend year by year, and most of them are in the areas of human activity. Except for extremely unhealthy and healthy levels, all grades showed a slow upward trend, which also led to a decrease in the proportion of healthy forests year by year. On a national scale, 50%-60% of the regional forest health in China is in a moderately healthy and sub-healthy state, while unhealthy forest areas account for 18%-21%, and are rising constantly year by year at 18.99%, 19.45%, and 20.76% respectively. The healthy and sub-healthy forest areas in Democratic People's Republic of Korea are on a downward trend in 2010. The sub-healthy forest areas have declined significantly compared with 2000 (25.4%, 7.54%). By 2020, the healthy and sub-healthy forests have continued to decrease by 2.47%. The extremely unhealthy and healthy regional forests in Russia's developed slowly. As a whole, the forest health has declined slightly (0.35%) from 2000 to 2020. In the cross-border region between China, DPRK and Russia, the forest health rank of the three countries is Russia>China>DPRK. This result can be promoted for local development and targeted construction. Through sustainable management and protection, it can provide an effective basis for the healthy development of local or regional forests, and can better protect and manage forest resources.

articleTitle: Corporate Green Technology Innovation, Equity Concentration and Corporate Carbon Performance: Empirical Evidence from Chinese Manufacturing Listed Companies
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: This article examines Chinese Manufacturing firms with A-shares listed in Shanghai and Shenzhen between 2010 and 2019 as a study sample It examines the connections and mechanisms between innovation in green technology within corporations, equity concentration, as well as corporate carbon performance using an interaction effect model. It was revealed that although encouraging innovation in green technology within corporations may assist businesses in reducing their corporate carbon performance, equity concentration has a detrimental impact on this connection. Last but not least, the South-North categorization test showed that although green technology innovation and corporate carbon performance. Finally, a significant positive driving impact of green technology innovation on corporate carbon performance in the North was found by the South-North classification test, but this driving impact was not reflected in the South. Therefore, clarifying the association between innovation in green technology within corporations, equity concentration as well as corporate carbon performance can help companies solve many fundamental challenges in carbon emission reduction, bring agile and efficient operation mode for companies, and is important to achieve long-term growth and sustainable change of corporate green innovation capacity.

articleTitle: Regional Integration and High-quality Enterprise Development : An empirical study from the Yangtze River Delta
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Taking the introduction of the Three-year Action Plan for the Integrated Development of the Yangtze River Delta Region (2018-2020) as a quasi-natural experiment, this paper empirically analyzes the policy impact of regional integration on the high-quality development of enterprises in the Yangtze River Delta region, and analyzes the underlying mechanism by using the difference method and the policy window width from 2013 to 2020. The empirical results show that the integration of the Yangtze River Delta region promotes the high-quality development of enterprises. The mechanism analysis shows that the regional integration of the Yangtze River Delta promotes the high-quality development of enterprises through the technological innovation mechanism, but the fixed assets mechanism inhibits the improvement of the high-quality development of enterprises, and the market transaction mechanism does not play a significant role in promoting the high-quality development of enterprises. The heterogeneity test shows that the regional integration of the Yangtze River Delta can better promote the high-quality development of private enterprises, enterprises in the eastern region and capital-intensive enterprises.

articleTitle: Digital Transformation, Corporate Governance and Enterprise Performance: Empirical Evidence from China
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: As part of this paper, we examine the impact of digital transformation and corporate governance on the performance of corporations by combining data from Shanghai and Shenzhen A-share companies listed between 2007 and 2020, evaluating corporate digital transformation and corporate governance separately through the entropy method, and using the moderating effect model for empirical analysis. The results show that the support of governance institutions can assist companies in improving their performance, while the development of corporate digital transformation has a positive impact on the productivity level of listed companies. However, it is found that the positive effect of digital transformation on corporate performance becomes weaker when the level of corporate governance is higher. Finally, a categorical test by non-state-owned and state-owned enterprises concludes that business digital transformation and corporate governance contribute significantly to driving impact on corporate performance both in state-owned and non-state-owned firms, but this driving effect has a greater impact on state-owned companies. The results provide insights for policymakers and regulators on the current practices of digital transformation and corporate governance and their potential economic impacts, which can be used to achieve a "coupled" development of digital transformation and corporate governance, reduce corporate costs, and better contribute to corporate performance.

articleTitle: Analysis of Influencing Factors of Cross-border Online Retail Development Based on Multivariate Regression Model: A Case Study of Zhejiang Province
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the continuous development of economic integration and the continuous update of electronic information technology, the status and influence of cross-border e-commerce in China's foreign trade are increasingly prominent, and gradually become a new driving force for the rapid development of China's economy. In recent years, the scale of goods trade in Zhejiang province has expanded, the Internet penetration rate has improved and the cross-border logistics system has become increasingly mature. At the same time, with the emergence of various cross-border online retail e-commerce platforms to provide convenience for consumers, cross-border online retail in Zhejiang province has developed rapidly and occupies a very important position in the development of China's foreign trade. This paper will use multivariate regression model to conduct empirical analysis on the factors influencing the development of cross-border online retail, the results show that the development level of logistics, the demand for commodity trade and the number of e-commerce specialized villages are of great significance to promote the development of cross-border online retail in Zhejiang. Finally, according to the empirical conclusions, suggestions are put forward to promote the further development of cross-border online retail, providing reference for relevant departments and enterprises of cross-border online retail.

articleTitle: A Study on the Coupling Coordination of Economy and Ecology in Hulunbuir
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Coordinated development of economic growth and ecological environment is an important way to achieve green and sustainable development, and it is also an important part of building a socialist harmonious society. In recent years, the contradiction between ecological environment and economic growth in Hulunbeier has become increasingly serious, and the deterioration of ecological environment will inevitably affect economic growth and development process. Based on the above background, this paper uses the data of economic Hulunbeier City and ecological indicators in Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region from 2003 to 2018, and uses the coupled coordination model as well as the gray correlation degree analysis to empirically analyze the level of coordinated economic and ecological development in Hulunbeier, and finds that the economy and ecology of Hulunbeier then during the period from 2008 to 2018 It is in a stable high level of coupling, followed by the management of environmental pollution and ecological environment level have a greater impact on the level of economic-ecological coupling and coordination in Hulunbeier, then the total economic volume and economic structure are also important factors affecting the level of economic-ecological coupling and coordination in Hulunbeier. Finally, indicators such as industrial waste emissions are also important influencing factors on the level of economic-ecological coupling and coordination in Hulunbeier.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Effect of Health Literacy on Alzheimer's Disease Cognition Based on Machine Learning Regression Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Objective To understand the current situation of community residents' knowledge of Alzheimer's disease, analyze the impact of residents' health literacy on the awareness rate based on machine regression, and provide countermeasures and suggestions for promoting the public's correct understanding and reasonable access to Alzheimer's disease related information. Methods In 2022, the residents of a community in Weifang City were sampled by stratified random sampling, and a prediction model of Alzheimer's disease cognitive level based on machine learning regression algorithm was proposed, and a common typical regression algorithm was used to predict the cognitive status based on health literacy level. Results The basic knowledge awareness rate was 34.7%, and the importance of the influencing factors was ranked according to the results of machine regression: health literacy, gender, education level, marital status, and average annual family income. In the dimension of skill awareness rate, the skill knowledge awareness rate was 14.0%, and the importance of the influencing factors was ranked according to the results of the machine learning regression algorithm, which was the average annual household income, occupation, education level, and type of residence. In the dimension of disease stress, disease stress accounted for 35.7%, and the top three influencing factors in the importance of machine regression results were health literacy, occupation, and chronic disease. Conclusion Through the comparison of the evaluation indicators of the prediction model, the prediction of the accurate cognitive level of Alzheimer's disease is effectively predicted, which provides a scientific basis for improving the cognitive level and health outcomes of Alzheimer's disease.

articleTitle: A Study on the Impact of "Cashback" on the Market and its Governance Status : Take the Data of Laundry Detergent on E-commerce Platform as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In recent years, China's e-commerce market has been developing rapidly, and the use of "cashback" as a new marketing tool has become more and more widespread, but this credit hype makes online reviews deviate from the authenticity and lose positive guidance, which is not conducive to the healthy development of e-commerce platforms.Firstly, based on game theory and data survey, this paper explores the factors affecting the strategy choice of each subject by establishing a game model of cashback and consumer behavior evolution. Secondly, the online review credibility evaluation model is established to provide support for the subsequent empirical main game model. In this paper, we analyze the market elements under the influence of cashback by using the correlation analysis between sales volume, sales volume and collection volume, and use Pearson correlation coefficient to indicate the strength of the correlation. We also crawl the information of the reviews corresponding to the products and use the natural language processing research method to propose a feasible governance mechanism for the market and the current situation of governance under the influence of positive feedback.

articleTitle: Research and Implementation of AIS and Radar Information Fusion Method
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The fusion of Automatic Identification System(AIS) and radar data can effectively improve the efficiency of sea surface target detection, and data preprocessing plays a vital role in information fusion. In view of the low fusion problem caused by radar data migration in the process of AIS and radar information fusion, a data preprocessing method based on outlier elimination method, linear interpolation method and Gauss-Kruger projection was proposed, and a mathematical model of multi-factor Euclilian distance association fusion algorithm based on data correction and coarse correlation processing was constructed. The AIS and radar base station data in Zhoushan, Zhejiang province were selected to carry out the sea experiment. Experiments show that the fusion rate of this method is increased by 14.1% compared with the traditional algorithm, and the accuracy of AIS and radar information fusion algorithm is effectively improved.

articleTitle: World Equity from Stars
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: More than 100 countries around the world ratified and signed the United Nations Outer Space Treaty in 1967, and with the increasing access of human beings to space-based resources, it is unclear whether this international commitment to equity is still valid. Based on scholars' research on the concept of equity, the variance of each country's development level is used to measure global equity. Eight indicators such as gross domestic product (GDP) and physician density were selected to obtain the corresponding weights through the entropy weight method, thereby obtaining the National Development Index (NDI) of the selected 224 countries. In addition, this paper selects 23 representative countries as samples to explore the link between asteroid mining and global equity, and uses energy use, the percentage of total domestic R&D expenditure in GDP, and the number of satellites launched as the scientific and technological capability index (STCI), and the Appropriate weights were derived using Analytic Hierarchy Process (AHP) as each country acts as a bridge between asteroid mining and global equity. The Lotka-Volterra model is used to establish a perfectly competitive differential equation for the mining of sample countries, and the changes in share from the perspective of per capita GDP and unemployment are used to evaluate the impact of global equity after the introduction of asteroid mining. Finally, this paper formulates international cooperation policies for different types of countries. Build a Shapley model for distribution of benefits, proving the effectiveness of a given policy in promoting global equity and maximizing the world's interests.

articleTitle: A Logistic Regression-based Early Warning System for Financial Risks under the Digital Transformation of Manufacturing Enterprises
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the rapid development of the digital economy, manufacturing enterprises have become the main battlefield for developing the digital economy, and digital transformation is a general trend. Various uncertainties encountered during the process of digital transformation of manufacturing enterprises, how to identify risks in advance in the digital transformation, timely risk avoidance, and risk control are critical to the transformation's success. As a result, establishing a financial early warning system for manufacturing enterprises undergoing digital transformation is critical. This paper introduces non-financial indicators on the basis of financial indicators, takes into account digital transformation, and uses Python crawlers to use text analysis to obtain the digital transformation of 20 manufacturing companies listed on the Shenzhen and Shanghai exchanges that are treated as ST in 2018-2022 and 20 companies in the same industry and of the same scale but with normal finances in that year. The financial indicators were then filtered using the K-S test, t-test, and Mann-Whitney U test, yielding a final set of 18 indicators. The final six principle components were extracted by factor analysis using the KMO and Bartlett tests, and a logistic regression financial risk early warning model was built with them to serve as a guide for manufacturing businesses and their stakeholders going through a digital transition.

articleTitle: Analysis of Urban-Rural Income Gap in China Based on Coupling Coordination Degree and Stepwise Regression Model
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: To narrow the income gap between urban and rural areas is an inevitable requirement of social development. Firstly, this paper establishes a coupling coordination degree model to quantitatively analyze the coupling degree between rural revitalization and digital economy. Then, the indexes that have great influence on the urban-rural gap and the ratio of urban-rural gap are screened out by stepwise regression method, and analyzed. Finally, ARIMA model is used to predict each index, and regression model is used to predict the change trend of urban-rural gap ratio, and corresponding suggestions are put forward.The advantages of this paper are: using the comprehensive evaluation method of rank sum ratio, it depends on the size of data, so it can show the slight changes of data and is not sensitive to outliers; The main factors affecting the income gap between urban and rural areas are selected by stepwise regression method, and then the panel model is used to demonstrate and analyze the results of the former, and the rationality of the conclusion is tested.

articleTitle: An Empirical Study on the Impact of Environmental Accounting Information Disclosure on Corporate Profitability : Based on the Perspective of Green Governance
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: With the national "double carbon" goal proposed and government supervision on environment strengthened, enterprises gradually add environmental accounting information disclosure items in annual reports. To stimulate the endogenous power of enterprises and achieve green governance, it is necessary to discuss the impact of environmental accounting information disclosure on corporate profitability. This paper takes the heavy pollution industry as sample. It establishes environmental accounting information disclosure index EDI and introduces government supervision as moderating variable. Through a series of theoretical analysis and empirical tests, it finds that environmental accounting information disclosure is positively correlated with corporate profitability, and that government supervision plays a positively moderating role.

articleTitle: Urban Innovation Evaluation Based on GIS and Big Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The innovation of a city directly affects the sustainable development of the city. On the basis of fully summarizing domestic and foreign researches, this paper selects 16 cities in Shandong Province as the research objects and constructs the urban innovation evaluation index system. This paper studies the first-level indicators and second-level indicators of knowledge, technology, environment and economy. SPSS is used to process the data and get the comprehensive evaluation results, and GIS is used to visually display the results. Finally, the paper analyzes the reasons of the evaluation results and puts forward the corresponding development suggestions.

articleTitle: Solution Design of Traceability System for E-commerce Agricultural Product Quality and Safety Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The quality and safety of agricultural products are concerned because they are related to the health of the Chinese people. It also has an important impact on the sustainable development of China's agriculture. It has always been the focus of our government and residents. With the construction of e-commerce platform and the change of people's online trading behavior, some quality and safety problems in the field of agricultural products have become increasingly worrying, such as acute poisoning caused by excessive pesticides, malicious addition of preservatives, and deterioration caused by improper storage of fresh agricultural products. These potential safety hazards seriously affect the health of consumers. In addition, the loose e-commerce market access system and backward administrative supervision and third-party platform supervision have led to frequent quality and safety incidents of agricultural products in recent years. In addition, the virtual trade environment further aggravates the information asymmetry in the circulation of agricultural products, making it difficult for consumers to intuitively identify the quality of products. The quality disputes of agricultural products on the e-commerce platform continue. Under the current e-commerce environment, how to take advantage of the opportunities brought by the development of e-commerce technology to effectively ensure the quality and safety of e-commerce agricultural products and meet people's new expectations for a better life is the focus of agricultural production, management, consumption and other aspects. It is a powerful guarantee for the quality and safety of agricultural products in today's e-commerce to reasonably solve the traceability problem of agricultural products. On this basis, it summarizes the deficiencies of the current traceability system of agricultural product quality and safety in China. Combining the characteristics of blockchain technology and the traceability of agricultural product quality and safety in e-commerce, a scheme of agricultural product quality and safety traceability system based on blockchain technology is designed, and the core nodes and collaborative traceability process of the system are discussed to ensure the reliability of the system.

articleTitle: Enterprise Digital Transformation and Debt Financing Capability<Subtitle>Evidence from Chinese Manufacturing Firms
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: We examine the benefits of enterprise digital transformation from the perspective of debt financing capacity. Considering the essentiality of enterprise digital transformation, we quantify digital transformation in two dimensions: the degree of digital technologies application and the level of investment in digital technologies, with textual analysis, machine learning, and manual collation. We find that digital transformation can significantly improve corporates debt financing capacity, and the effect is particularly remarkable among state-owned enterprises, which receive substantial government support and policy subsidies. The findings extend the microeconomic effects of digital transformation and provide empirical evidence for the government in guiding enterprise digital transformation.

articleTitle: Research on Social Responsibility of Digital Platform Enterprise : Tencent as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: In the era of digital economy, digital technology is developing rapidly and becoming increasingly popular in economic and social life, but in the process of rapid expansion, China's digital development has also exposed many more prominent social problems, such as hidden dangers of network security and obvious regional disparities. Taking Tencent, a typical representative platform enterprise, as an example, this paper will explore the social responsibility requirements of digital platform-based enterprises using the single-case analysis method and the rooted theory case study method, enrich the literature on the social responsibility of digital platform-based enterprises, provide a theoretical basis for strengthening the social responsibility governance of digital platform enterprises, and provide meaningful insights for government departments to improve policies related to the governance of digital platforms.

articleTitle: Exploring the Influencing Factors of Digital Economy Based on Principal Component Analysis Method : Taking Shanghai as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: Identifying the influencing factors of the digital economy in Shanghai, China, has a very strong motivation and practical significance to improve the economic development of Shanghai. Therefore, this paper proposes an analysis model of the influencing factors of the digital economy in Shanghai based on the principal component analysis method. Firstly, from the perspective of the influencing factors of the digital economy, the indicators of the influencing factors of the digital economy in Shanghai is preliminarily selected, then the person coefficient correlation is used to screen the indicators, and finally the principal component analysis method is applied to construct the influencing factors of the digital economy in Shanghai. The index system and identified three key factors affecting Shanghai's digital economy, namely, the gross domestic product of the tertiary industry, public substation capacity, and R&D expenditure.

articleTitle: Multiple Imputation by Chained Equations for Missing Data in UK Biobank
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: UK Biobank is a large cohort study and faces missing data problems. The complexity of observations in this dataset, including noisy data, different missing rates, and the diversity of the data distributions and data types, results in the challenge of imputing missing data in the dataset. With the aim of addressing this issue and imputing missing values in UK Biobank, we propose an imputation framework based on prior knowledge and multiple imputation by chained equations (MICE), which consists of three parts: (1) Data cleaning for eliminating the interference of noisy data, (2) Correction of imputation illegibility for high missing rate subjects and low variance variables, and (3) MICE for imputing different types of independent variables. By comparing the imputation results of linear regression, linear regression with bootstrap, Bayesian linear regression, and random forest for continuous and categorical variables, we find that the best imputation model for continuous variables is linear regression, with the normalized mean absolute error (MAE) of 0.072+/-0.004 in the experiment of actual missing percentage, while the best imputation model for categorical variables is random forest, with the normalized MAE of 0.129+/-0.003. By comparing the imputation results of logistic regression, logistic regression with bootstrap, and random forest for binary variables, we find that the best imputation model is random forest, with the accuracy of 0.907+/-0.008 in the experiment of actual missing percentage. In addition, the data cleaning improves the imputation accuracy by 6.83% overall. The correction of high-missing rate variables is also a significant step, the imputation accuracy of all types of variables is 0.842+/- 0.006, 0.826+/-0.006, 0.793+/-0.005, 0.766+/-0.007, and 0.742+/- 0.006 when the missing percentage is 50%, 60%, 70%, 80%, and 90%, respectively.

articleTitle: Research on Forecasting for Different Types of Small Sample Time Series Data
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: For small sample time series data, we can use various methods to analyze and predict it, but the inherent laws of the data will affect the experimental results. To find out which methods are suitable for different types of small sample time series data, this paper conducts a time series analysis on three datasets: China’s private car ownership, China’s urban unemployment rate, and China’s population. Evaluate the model according to indicators such as SSR, SSR, AIC, etc., and find the most suitable model for analyzing different types of small sample time series data. The experimental results show that the polynomial regression model is suitable for analyzing private car ownership in my country, and the fitting effect is good. The grey prediction model and the polynomial regression model are suitable for modeling and analysis of the Chinese population. The ARIMA(p,d,q) model is suitable for modeling and analysis of China’s urban unemployment rate, and the selected ARIMA model is ARIMA(0,1,0).

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Entrepreneurial Competency Model of Returned College Students Based on Binary Semantic Fuzzy Evaluation
publicationTitle: 2022 6th Annual International Conference on Data Science and Business Analytics (ICDSBA)
abstract: The proposal of rural revitalization strategy and "mass entrepreneurship and innovation" has provided an important opportunity for college students to return to their hometown and start their own businesses. College students' return to their hometown and entrepreneurship not only inject new energy into the new rural construction, but also drive the development of rural economy in the process of realizing their self value. Due to the influence of the country, schools, individuals and other factors, college graduates are highly motivated to return home and start their own businesses, but their entrepreneurial performance is poor. In view of this situation, based on literature analysis and expert interviews, this paper constructs a entrepreneurial competency model for returned college students, which includes 4 level-1 indicators and 13 level-2 indicators, and determines the weight of indicators at all levels with the help of analytic hierarchy process. In order to ensure the operability of the model, the binary semantic fuzzy evaluation method is used to quantify the indicators, and the model is used to evaluate the entrepreneurial competency of a returned college student.
